body:
Live-found: the AGI --continue session had grown to 463.7MB, past the API's 32MB request cap. Existing context-overflow recovery only matched token/context-window phrasing, not this request-size wording, so it never fired -- the outer poll loop just kept retrying the same poisoned session forever (new claude child spawning/dying every ~15-30s, undetected). Fixed isContextTooLongOutput() to also match 'request too large'/'32MB request limit'. Verified live post-fix: recovery now fires correctly on first occurrence; the fresh-session retry landed on the separate, already-tracked HITL-11 credit-balance cooldown instead of respawning again. Commit 40ec4c6.

⚓ ☃
title: observation-watcher: fix infinite respawn loop on 32MB request-size overflow
